apps.name: Sound2U
apps.description: Wereldwijde radio, podcasts, audiobulletins en lokale audio met Save2U, Stats2U en Wake2U.
apps.changelog:
Stability and efficiency update
Improved network request cancellation, playback lifecycle handling and background efficiency. Prevents outdated searches, artwork downloads and source requests from continuing after they are no longer needed. Updated Media3 to 1.11.1 while retaining the existing M3U/audio offload battery optimizations.

apps.name: Esmarty
apps.description: Material You app voor het vinden en vergelijken van lokale prepaid-eSIMs.
apps.changelog:
Esmarty 0.6.0

  UI redesign
- Simplified the main navigation to Discover, Trips and Wallet.
- Favorites are now integrated into Discover.
- Comparing eSIMs is now contextual instead of using a permanent tab.
- Added more compact and easier-to-scan eSIM cards.
- Added a Best match section to country pages.
- Improved the upcoming trip overview.

  Translate 2.0
- Improved automatic website translation with on-device ML Kit.
- System language now follows all supported device languages.
- Added Dutch, English, Spanish, German, French, Italian and Portuguese as explicit translation targets.
- Translation now works with larger contextual text blocks for more natural results.
- Visible website content is translated first for faster perceived performance.
- Added support for dynamically loaded website content.
- Protected technical terms such as eSIM, SIM, APN, 5G, GB and prices from unnecessary translation.
- Added a temporary local translation cache.
- Added an option to download translation models over Wi-Fi only.

  Provider browser
- Improved the built-in provider browser.
- Official provider domains are now clearly identified.
- Leaving the verified provider domain is clearly indicated.
- Login, cart, checkout and payment flows continue to open in the system browser.
- Improved page title and translation status presentation.

  Performance
- No periodic background polling was added.
- Translation processing only runs while the in-app browser is active.
- Improved translation batching and debouncing to reduce unnecessary CPU usage.

apps.name: Weather2U
apps.description: Modern weather app with forecasts, rain radar, official warnings, widgets and smart background alerts.
apps.changelog:
Stability and efficiency update
Improved background weather refresh coordination, request cancellation, cache reliability and alert scheduling. Prevents duplicate weather and warning requests between the app, widgets and background monitoring. Improved map loading efficiency and location request handling while preserving existing MeteoAlarm, radar, forecast and widget functionality.

apps.name: SkyRadar
apps.description: Live aircraft spotting met vliegtuigfoto's, kaart, slimme meldingen en uitgebreide spotterfuncties.
apps.changelog:
SkyRadar 1.0.0-alpha13.0

- Completely redesigned Material 3 interface.
- Nearby aircraft is now the default home screen.
- Aircraft cards show photos, distance, altitude, speed, registration and aircraft type.
- Tap an aircraft to open and select it directly on the live map.
- Added smart proximity notifications.
- Filter notifications by radius, airline and aircraft type.
- Added maximum altitude filters.
- Added favorite aircraft registrations and alerts.
- Added special aircraft filtering for aircraft such as the A380, Boeing 747, Antonov and military traffic.
- Added likely-overflight detection using distance, altitude, speed and heading.
- Added Spotter section with Favorites and Today.
- Today records nearby aircraft including minimum distance and time of passage.
- Improved aircraft photo matching and caching.
- Improved location updates, navigation and overall stability.

apps.name: Customer Nearby
apps.description: Wereldwijde klantenservicezoeker met telefoon, WhatsApp, e-mail, websites en storingsinformatie.
apps.changelog: Customer Nearby 0.2.13 - Added direct curated Netherlands customer-service call actions for DELTA (0118 22 55 75), Ziggo (0900 1884) and Odido (0800 0092), while retaining existing KPN/Vodafone/Guidion profiles. - Added Odido's international service number and normalized current first-party support routes for Ziggo and Odido. - Booking.com NL now shows a descriptive Bericht of bel 24/7 action that opens Booking.com's official localized support flow instead of inventing a fixed phone number. - Contact-cache schema bumped to 7 so older sparse cached profiles cannot hide new curated contact actions. - Split outage routing into a user-facing preferred status URL and a separate regional automatic-detection URL. - KPN, Ziggo, Odido and DELTA now open verified first-party status/service checkers from the outage UI where available. - Added DELTA to the Netherlands outage catalogue. - Added a 30-minute per-country automatic backoff after regional outage-source 403/429 responses, preventing repeated Home/company-open retries against a temporarily blocked source. - Manual outage refresh may still explicitly retry; failed/unparseable checks remain UNKNOWN and never become false outage cards. - Added Dutch/English/Spanish strings for the new official-status and Booking.com contact UI. - Version bumped to 0.2.13 / versionCode 17.

apps.name: Data2U
apps.description: Smart mobile data tracking with app usage, SIM/eSIM insights, roaming, forecasts and widgets.
apps.changelog:
Stability and measurement reliability update
Improved NetworkStats coordination, Speed2U cancellation, call usage refresh handling and carrier database updates. Prevents overlapping heavy measurements, stale results and network operations continuing after they are no longer needed.

apps.name: GetMe
apps.description: Eigen Material You appcatalogus en veilige updater voor directe APK-releases.
apps.changelog:
Stability and update reliability improvements

Improved catalog refresh coordination to prevent overlapping foreground and background updates.
Added true network cancellation for catalog and APK requests.
Improved APK download and resume validation using stronger release identity checks.
Added validation for partial downloads, Content-Range responses and expected APK size.
Resume failures now automatically fall back to one clean full download.
Improved pause and cancel handling so old download jobs fully stop before files are reused or removed.
Added a proper installer queue so multiple completed downloads can no longer overwrite each other.
Installer cleanup now removes only the APK that was actually handled by Android Package Installer.
Improved the “Install unknown apps” flow with dedicated Activity Result handling.
Preserved the existing FileProvider, URI permission, resumable download and installer reliability fixes from v1.5.2.
Improved Wi-Fi-only handling, including devices using Wi-Fi through an active VPN.
Already downloaded APKs can now be installed without requiring Wi-Fi.
Moved stale download cleanup away from the main thread for smoother startup.
Strengthened GitHub release validation against versionCode rollbacks, signer changes and mismatched APKs.
Improved APK signing validation, including signing-key rotation handling.
